none: PAS LIN-051F16: Roman silver finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Treasure reference number 2013 T843: A broken Roman silver finger ring. It has a raised circular bezel bearing an inscribed letter 'M', presumbly an abbreviation for the god-name Mars or Mercury. The ring is broken across both shoulders, and these both appear to have been triangular and decorated. Probably Henig type VIII
